description.subtitle: Pre-party warm-up T-shirt Austrian selection 2026 - navy blue
description.tagline: Calienta como los profesionales de Austria
description.intro: The Puma Austria 2026 Pre-Match T-shirt is designed for the moments before the match, offering comfort and performance while you're preparing to jump into the field. Inspired by the one used by players during the warm-up, it combines style and functionality.
key_benefits: Official pre-match design: Same line used by players before the match.
Lightweight fabric: Promotes mobility and comfort during heating.
Alta transpirabilidad: Mantiene la piel seca y fresca.
Fast drying: Evacuate sweat for optimal performance.
Estilo moderno: Ideal tanto para entrenar como para uso casual.

key_benefits: Diseño oficial pre-match: Misma línea que usan los jugadores antes del partido.
Tejido ligero: Favorece la movilidad y la comodidad durante el calentamiento.
Alta transpirabilidad: Mantiene la piel seca y fresca.
Secado rápido: Evacua el sudor para un rendimiento óptimo.
Estilo moderno: Ideal tanto para entrenar como para uso casual.
